Messages.Author: Joe Churchill
Messages.Body:
In article <98ig6s$1u5g$1...@www.univie.ac.at>, Ferenci Stefan says...

>
>Hi
>
>my predator plays Golconda on my Lambach i don´t pay 2 blood and play reform
>body what happens. do i get the 10 pool or not
>

Nothing because Golconda removes the vampire from play. It does not per current
card text burn the vampire.

Joe Churchill
Editor: Tzimisce Clan Newsletter
